messages:
infra-bot: Pager — kubelet restart loop detected on infer-pool-usw. 3 nodes flapping to NotReady in last 2m, autoscaler reacting, some requests failing. alert: https://infra.monitoring/alerts/ID12345

sara_oncall: I'm taking primary for this. Paging eng-sre.

jonah: Looking now. Running quick node check:
```
NAME                 STATUS     ROLES    AGE
infer-usw-03         NotReady   <none>   12d
infer-usw-07         NotReady   <none>   8d
infer-usw-09         NotReady   <none>   3d
infer-usw-01         Ready      <none>   40d
```

mei: Journal shows repeated kubelet restarts and GPU watchdog resets. dmesg has NV driver messages + OOM hints. Tail: 
```
Mar 23 12:10:41 kubelet[1234]: runtime: segfault at 0 ip 0x...
Mar 23 12:10:42 kernel: NVRM: GPU watchdog: Tainted kernel - reset requested
Mar 23 12:10:42 containerd: task: container "rerank-job-xyz" exited with status 137 (OOM)
```

ops_lead: Any immediate customer impact? @customer-svcs

customer-svcs: We're seeing a handful of hosted API customers with 5-12% latency increase and intermittent 429s. Opening tickets for top 10 affected.

luis: Could be KV cache pressure + a heavy rerank workload bump. That combination has caused GPU OOMs before.

sara_oncall: Proposed plan: do not drain immediately (we'll lose KV caches). Step 1: shift traffic off the unstable nodes to eu-west fallback, scale eu-west by +2. Step 2: try soft-reboot on unreachable nodes, then cordon/drain if they come back stable. Mei — can you confirm we can shift without dropping in-flight sessions?

mei: Draining would evict KV caches and cause a cold hit; better to shift routing first. I'm pushing a traffic-shift policy now.

deploy-bot: Routing policy "infer-routing->fallback-eu" set to trigger when nodeNotReady >= 2. Triggering policy now.

infra-bot: Traffic shift executed at 1777777085 — 30% traffic to eu-west fallback, 70% remaining us nodes. Autoscaler increased infer-eu by 2 replicas.

jonah: Attempting cordon on infer-usw-03 to preserve local state before reboot: `kubectl cordon infer-usw-03`

jonah: cordon failed: `error: node is unreachable` — kubelet handshake timing out.

mei: If node is unreachable we'll try a remote reboot. Queuing admin reboot via admin-runner: `admin-runner run --host infer-usw-03 --cmd 'sudo reboot'`

ops_lead: Do we have a recent driver/OS change on these hosts? Could be correlated.

mei: There was a driver rollout yesterday (nvidia-driver 515.76 -> 515.90) to this cohort. Reboot first; if unstable, plan rollback.

luis: Logs show repeated CUDA OOM inside a rerank pod: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory allocating 20480 bytes` — looks like batch-size spike. I'll temporarily throttle rerank batch sizes for the pool.

customer-svcs: Status update posted to affected customers: "We've detected instability on a subset of inference nodes in US-West. Traffic is being shifted and engineers are investigating. We will provide updates."

ops_lead: Good. If this isn't stabilised in 15m escalate to SEV-2 with exec team.

mei: Reboots issued at 1777777180. infer-usw-09 returned Ready at 1777777240, infer-usw-03 still flapping, infer-usw-07 unreachable.

jonah: Manually applied pod anti-affinity to avoid colocating heavy rerank pods on the same host. Patch snippet:
```yaml
affinity:
  podAntiAffinity:
    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
            - key: app
              operator: In
              values: ["rerank"]
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
```

sara_oncall: Monitoring metrics: error rate dropped from ~6% -> ~1.2% after traffic shift and throttles. Latency approaching baseline. :thumbsup:

customer-svcs: Notifying customers that we're seeing recovery and will keep the incident ticket open while we monitor.

ops_lead: Who's owning postmortem? Recommend runtime + infra (Mei + Jonah). Action items: revert driver in affected pool if confirmed, add preflight test for driver rollout, adjust autoscaler thresholds and routing SLOs.

mei: I'll open the postmortem and link the timeline + logs. Assigning to @mei and @jonah. Will include rollback playbook and rerank batch-size guard.

sara_oncall: Closing pager for now. I'll monitor for 1 hour and hand to next oncall. Temporary mitigation: limit rerank batch sizes for infer-pool-usw until driver rollout verified.

ops_lead: Thanks everyone — keep notes in the incident tracker and ping if anything regresses.
